method: Fresh diff, proposal, inventory, manual runner, handler, CDP client, active-tab resolver, and stabilization contract review. Source only; no tests, browser, build, database, permission, or runtime execution.

verdict_A_spec_and_procedure.overall: ACCEPT for inventory procedure integration as an unverified proposal; no case status or permission/dispatcher coverage promotion

EXT-F-4112-T01.reason: Both roles and reload passes now require baseline/delta/exact-ID cleanup, with member diagnostic reachability distinguished from dispatcher access.

verdict_B_quality_and_truth.overall: ACCEPT for source-derived procedure quality with runtime explicitly UNVERIFIED

prior_findings.ownership_and_cleanup: ADDRESSED: each positive path captures a pre-operation list, requires one uniquely identified new ID tied to the still-focused owned tab without concurrent attachment activity, and detaches only that ID while preserving baseline entries.
prior_findings.full_build_receipt: ADDRESSED: shared setup now cites and enumerates the full PLAN build/reload receipt fields.
prior_findings.permission_denial_limit: ADDRESSED AS LIMIT: the proposal keeps pre-granted debugger permission as a precondition and expressly disclaims permission enforcement or dispatcher denial; those dimensions remain unverified.
prior_findings.member_admin_only_diagnostics: ADDRESSED: member use of cdp_attached_tabs and cdp_detach is expressly diagnostic, with no dispatcher access conclusion.

integration_limit: Integrate the five procedures only as proposed steps. Live role, lifecycle, permission-denied, dispatcher, and agent-routing verdicts require separate authorized execution and evidence.
